name: Morning run, then a second run the same day
description: Normal morning: stale catalog stock (P01), landed cost (P02), job deadline (P04), unapproved supplier and over-limit order (P06). Then a same-day rerun that must order nothing new.
instruction: You are Louie. Ask the purchasing agent to run this morning's parts check. Read what it ordered. Then ask it to run again, to make sure it doesn't double order.
stop_rules: Stop after the agent has reported on the second run.
